verdict.rationale: Mastra ships an official MCP server, `@mastra/mcp-docs-server`, documented as working with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and other MCP clients, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. The framework also lets developers author their own MCP servers that expose agents and tools. Missing for 10: the official server only covers documentation access, with no evidence of an official MCP server for operating or controlling Mastra projects; there is also no independent or hands-on confirmation that the server works.
